claims.text: Valproate: ⍉for migraine prophylaxis in preg, or in women of childbearing potential ⍉using effective contraception.
claims.quote: Valproate is therefore contraindicated for prophylaxis of migraine headaches in pregnant women and in women of childbearing potential who are not using effective contraception

claims.text: Topiramate in preg: major congenital malformations (incl cleft lip/palate) and sm for gestational age.
claims.quote: use during pregnancy can cause major congenital malformations, including but not limited to cleft lip and/or palate, and being small for gestational age
